notes:
Summary: Caduceus (Medfolio) is an enterprise EHR/clinical search product used by regional hospital systems. They need an embedding + rerank stack to power clinician search across notes, radiology reports, and care plans.

Key requirements / customer voice: 
- "We must guarantee PHI never leaves our VPC unless via BAA-approved flow."
- 30M doc target (mix of structured notes & free-text), average doc ~400 tokens.
- Query profile: peak 25 QPS, steady 5-8 QPS, 95/99 latency SLOs: 150ms/300ms for top-K retrieval+rerank.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high (hospital budgets); looking for clear cost per query modeling.

POC scope: 
- Embeddings store + ANN retrieval for 30M vectors (vector dims TBD), hybrid BM25 fallback for short queries.
- Reranking: bi-encoder for candidate scoring, cross-encoder fallback for top-8 for high-precision results.
- Privacy: in-flight encryption, KMS integration, detailed audit logs per request, retention controls.

Technical notes / questions: 
- Indexing cadence: nightly bulk ingest + nearline incremental for same-day notes. Need CDC hooks.
- Storage: estimate 30M vectors -> ~120GB (quantized), ask for Redwood quantization profile & approximate cost.
- Rerank latency: worried about cross-encoder at scale; want canary for dedicated nodes with pinning.
- Redaction: customer has PII scrubber but wants Redwood to support token-level redaction hooks and invocation metadata.

Procurement / legal: 
- BAA required before any PHI transfer. Legal flagged data residency (must remain in US regions).
- SLA negotiation around 99.9% uptime for dedicated/private deploys.

Sales snippets / next actions: 
- Schedule security design workshop (requested by Amira) — include infra, networking, and compliance.
- Provide a worked example cost-per-query for 30M dataset at 5/25 QPS with quantization options.
- Draft BAA + reference SOC2 docs; share dedicated capacity pricing band.

Stated blockers (quoted during calls): 
- "Need BAA before we can run any test with real notes"
- "Procurement needs concrete latency SLAs tied to dedicated capacity pricing"

Recent sentiment: engaged, pragmatic; willing to do POC if BAA and network diagrams are clear.
